title: Puthoff's EarthTech papers as a guide

tellings.quote: Pudoff, but I I find his work absolutely fascinating. His entire set of papers on his EarthTech website is every is uh acted as a a mentor-type guide to me.

plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff has posted a full set of research papers on the website of EarthTech, his research group, and one man says those papers served as his mentor. Dave Rossi, who says aliens taught him advanced physics, tells Michels in 2025 that Puthoff's work is "absolutely fascinating" and "acted as a mentor-type guide to me." He tells it to explain how he made sense of the physics he says he received.
